# Test photo attribution

All photos are from Wikimedia Commons and are in the public domain as works of the United States
federal government. Each was resized so its longest side is at most 640 px and saved as JPEG.
Licenses were checked through the Commons API (`LicenseShortName` "Public domain" and the listed
template). The people shown do not endorse this project.
